description: investigate and decompose gap dead-environment-line-plus-stale-fallback-caused-fossil-path-misdiagnosis: development-vessel.service declares Environment=WORKSPACE_ROOT=/workspace, but /etc/substrate/env (loaded via EnvironmentFile=, which wins over a unit's own Environment= per systemd semantics) sets WORKSPACE_ROOT=/workspace/git/super-repo. The unit-level line can never take effect and is dead config. Separately, config.ts's WORKSPACE_ROOT fallback default is /workspace, matching the dead unit line
